unit: accepted TRAIN-pair quotas, not independent scenario counts
promotion_rule: Candidate generation is CREATE_ONLY and may proceed in assigned batches. Admission and scaling student training require a separately requested semantic review and valid learning pilot. No production integration.
budget_rule: Parent/profile pools total 132000 TRAIN pairs; assigned complete groups 131987, unallocated reserve 13. Objective allocations replace covered parent streams; pilot TRAIN is included. DEV/EXAM are independent held-out data. All values are planned quotas, not observed generation or learning.
allocation_method: Divide each parent/profile pool equally in complete_group_size units; assign affordable remainder to smallest allocation, execution-order tie break. Keep remainder reserve.

budget_pools.reserve_reason: Incomplete class/family group cannot be allocated.
